heard: From Jechoniah's line in the captive's land Shelter the son holding the hand Of Malchuram, Padaiah, and Shenazah Jechoniah, Hoshamah, and Adabiah From Pedah's house, Zerubbabel rose With Shammai his brother, the line is close Meshulam and Hananiah, sons of the king Shalometh their sister, the bond is strong Hananya I am Named in the royal
